column2: Unsaved-changes warning fires only when leaving the basic-info group, not between its sub-tabs
column11: The eight left-panel basic-info sub-tabs (Local Information, Currency, Pricing, Account and Address, Legal, Notes, Shared Setup Locations, Auto Add-On) share one global Save, so switching among them with unsaved changes shows no warning and the edits carry across sub-tabs - a single Save commits them all. Leaving that group - to another setup module such as Corporate Pricing, or to the Management History tab - shows an "Unsaved changes" dialog with "Stay" and "Discard" buttons
column16:
Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Account and Address tab is active

  2. 2. Without saving, switch to another basic-info sub-tab (for example Local Information, Currency, Legal, or Notes). Confirm no warning appears and the edit is retained.
  3. 3. Still without saving, switch away from the basic-info group - to another setup module such as Corporate Pricing, or to the Management History tab.
  4. 4. Observe the "Unsaved changes" dialog with "Stay" and "Discard" buttons.
  5. 5. Reload the page to discard any remaining changes
column26:

4. The Unsaved changes dialog is displayed with Stay and Discard buttons.
5. The eight left-panel basic-info sub-tabs (Local Information, Currency, Pricing, Account and Address, Legal, Notes, Shared Setup Locations, Auto Add-On) share one global Save, so switching among them with unsaved changes shows no warning and the edits carry across sub-tabs - a single Save commits them all. Leaving that group - to another setup module such as Corporate Pricing, or to the Management History tab - shows an "Unsaved changes" dialog with "Stay" and "Discard" buttons
